## What happened

Attempt 2 (eshyra-289j) was asked to ADD an unmatched-preserved-entry case to
`packages/core/test/itemTimers.test.ts`. It instead REPLACED the existing
assertion that a preserved dice-defined timer is never re-rolled: the throwing
`Rng` (`nextInt: () => { throw new Error('preserved timer must not roll') }`)
and its `preservedRolled` fixture were deleted, and the `Rng` type import went
with them. That guarantee is now uncovered.

It matters beyond the deadline value: re-resolving a preserved timer would draw
from the seeded RNG stream, desyncing every later roll in a replayed session.

## Task

In `packages/core/test/itemTimers.test.ts`, restore that assertion **alongside**
the unmatched case attempt 2 added — keep both, do not trade one for the other:

- a declaration whose `from`+`to` matches an entry in `preserved`, resolved with
  an `Rng` whose `nextInt` throws, asserting the preserved timer is returned
  verbatim (anchor, deadline, amount, unit, and `roll` all unchanged) and that
  no roll occurred;
- the existing unmatched case, which must keep resolving fresh against the
  clock.

Split into two `it(...)` blocks if that reads better than one. Restore the
`import type { Rng }` line that was removed.

## Constraints

- Tests only. If you think production code must change, stop and report it in

- Do not weaken, delete, or trade away any existing assertion
  (`docs/importer-fix-protocol.md`).
